questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses inversion for emphasis in a conditional clause?
options: Only if you had studied harder would you have passed the exam.
Had you studied harder, you would have passed the exam.
If you had studied harder, you would have passed the exam.
You would have passed the exam if you had studied harder.
questions.answer: Had you studied harder, you would have passed the exam.

questions.question: Which cleft sentence correctly restates the subject and object in a way that highlights the object?
options: It was the proposal that was the cause of the argument.
The argument was caused by it being the proposal.
The proposal was the reason for the argument.
It was the proposal that caused the argument.
questions.answer: It was the proposal that caused the argument.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses the subjunctive mood with a hypothetical condition involving a past event?
options: She insists that he **be** invited to the party tomorrow.
She insists that he **be** invited to the party yesterday.
She insists that he **was** invited to the party yesterday.
She insists he **was** invited to the party tomorrow.
questions.answer: She insists that he **be** invited to the party yesterday.

questions.question: Which sentence demonstrates the use of ellipsis in a complex sentence structure?
options: Although she was tired, she finished the report before lunch.
She finished the report before lunch, tired though she was.
She finished the report, tired, before lunch.
She finished the report, tired, before she was lunch.
questions.answer: She finished the report, tired though she was.

questions.question: Which sentence uses a nuanced formal register with a passive construction and a conditional clause for emphasis?
options: Had the evidence been presented clearly, the case would have been dismissed.
The case would have been dismissed if the evidence had been presented clearly.
The evidence was presented clearly, so the case was dismissed.
The case was dismissed because the evidence was not clearly presented.
questions.answer: Had the evidence been presented clearly, the case would have been dismissed.
